title: Schema for norm-rules.json
description: Each normative tag in a standards document is one normative rule. The rule name is the tag name without the "norm:" prefix.

name.description: Normative rule name (the tag name without the "norm:" prefix)

chapter_name.description: Title of the chapter in the standards document that contains the tag

text.description: Text of the tag in the standards document

tag_filename.description: Name of the tag file that contains the tag

stds_doc_url.description: URL of the standards document that contains the tag
